description:
*The creaky cooperation between Su-Hwa, a goblin who hates humans, and Lee-Ho, who loves humans, begins.*

Su-Hwa, a brush goblin who lost her family and power due to human betrayal. When she meets the foolish grand prince Lee-Ho by chance, she finds that her strength has been restored and decides to grant his wish to fully restore her strength. The wish of the foolish young man Lee Ho, who laughs and calls himself the neighborhood drummer, is to reveal the truth about his mother's death. The shaky cooperation between Su-Hwa, who hates humans, and Lee Ho, who loves humans, begins, but as they spend more time together, memories of her past life begin to come to Su-Hwa's mind little by little. Those are also painful and painful memories related to Lee-Ho...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
